title: security-compliance-review-prep-1on1-ryan-kim-2026-03-04
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep with Priya (Security Lead) and Maya (Compliance PM)
Date: 2026-03-05 10:00am PT (internal prep notes)
Location: Zoom / notes to paste into Confluence after

Purpose:
- Quick sync to align on audit readiness status for incoming SOC2 readiness check and ISO scoping questions.
- Surface blockers on evidence collection and vendor risk inventory.
- Confirm owners and near-term action items for the external readiness review on 2026-03-15.

Attendees to invite to core review (confirm with Priya):
- Priya Desai (Security Lead)
- Maya Thompson (Compliance PM)
- Aaron Patel (SRE lead)
- Ryan Kim (notes / vendor owner follow-ups)
- Optional: Eng manager for Serving Runtime (if infra evidence missing)

Agenda (15-20 min):
1) Quick status recap (2-3 min) — what’s green/yellow/red across control domains
2) Evidence gaps checklist (5-7 min) — SOC2 CC and ISO artifacts we still need
3) Vendor risk & third-party inventory (4 min) — outstanding vendor attestations, contracts
4) Short-term plan & owners (5 min) — who will produce evidence before 3/15
5) Quick Qs for external auditor (if time)

High-level status (my current read):
- Policies: Mostly in good shape. InfoSec policy doc updated Feb 2026 but need sign-off from Legal.
- Access Controls (CC6/ISO A.9): SSO enabled org-wide, but we lack admin access review evidence for 3rd-party service accounts (serving runtime ops).
- Change Management (CC3): PR review policy exists; need sampled change tickets and deployment runbook excerpts.
- Logging & Monitoring (CC7): Central logs live in ELK; provide retention/archival config screenshots + SLOs.
- Vendor management: Vendor inventory exists but PIA/attestation docs missing for two vendors (cache provider, metrics vendor).

Evidence gaps (explicit items to chase):
- Admin access review: CSV export from Okta for owner/admin roles (Aaron) — due 2026-03-09
- Sampled change tickets: three production change PRs + deployment notes (Eng release team) — due 2026-03-10
- Logging retention screenshots: ELK index lifecycle policies + backup config (SRE) — due 2026-03-09
- Vendor attestations: SOC2/ISO snippets or contracts for CacheCo and MetricsHub (Vendor owners) — due 2026-03-11
- Encryption key management evidence: KMS policy + recent key rotation log (Infra) — due 2026-03-10
- Incident response drill notes: tabletop exercise summary + timeline for last 12 months (Sec Ops) — due 2026-03-12

Questions to raise with Priya / auditor prep: 
- For vendor exceptions: what level of attestations is acceptable (self-attestation vs SOC2 report)?
- For development/test environments: do we need separate evidence or can we scope to production-only controls?
- Sampling for change management: auditor typically requests 3-5 samples; confirm acceptance of PRs + deployment tickets combo.
- Time window for logs: auditor expects 90-day vs 12-month retention; confirm minimum they will check.

Action items (owner / due):
- Aaron Patel: Okta admin roles export + written admin-review process (2026-03-09)
- Eng Release (assign to Eng Lead): Pull 3 sample change tickets + deployment notes (2026-03-10)
- Maya Thompson: Vendor outreach template + send to CacheCo / MetricsHub requesting SOC2 reports or completed questionnaire (2026-03-06)
- Ryan Kim: Collate evidence pack folder structure in Drive and update Confluence evidence matrix (2026-03-07)
- Priya Desai: Legal sign-off on InfoSec policy & cover memo for auditor (2026-03-08)
- Infra: KMS policy export and rotation logs (2026-03-10)
- Sec Ops: Incident drill summary + MRT timeline (2026-03-12)

Quick notes / conversation snippets to capture during 1:1:
- Priya likely wants a short cover memo for the auditor highlighting major changes since last audit (Focus on Dedicated & Private features launched in 2025).
- Emphasize model-serving confidentiality controls: note where customer data is isolated (dedicated/private) and where hosted API logs are redacted. Need an excerpt for auditor.
- For vendor metrics: ask whether we can accept MetricsHub’s ISO attestation in lieu of SOC2 report (makes procurement easier).

Risks & blockers to call out now:
- Two vendors without attestations (CacheCo, MetricsHub) — procurement and vendor-security need to prioritize. If they can’t produce, plan B is tighter compensating controls (network restrictions, token scoping).
- Admin reviews: we have SSO but not an automated quarterly admin review process documented. Auditor will flag if reviewers not evident.
- Evidence owner bandwidth: Eng/release and infra teams are stretched — might need SE backup to assemble docs.

Notes-to-self (follow-up after meeting):
- Take owner list and create a short weekly cadence (every Tues) until 3/15 to check progress.
- Draft short email template for vendor attestations (include timeline & acceptable docs).
- Populate Confluence evidence matrix with links to Drive artifacts and mark each item with owner/due/status.
- Prepare a 1-page auditor exec summary (what changed since last audit, major risks, mitigation).

Docs to attach to evidence folder (drive path suggestion):
- info-security-policy-2026-02.pdf
- okta-admin-roles-export-2026-03-09.csv (placeholder until retrieved)
- sampled-change-tickets-2026-03.zip
- elk-retention-screenshots-2026-03.pdf
- kms-rotation-log-2026-03-01.csv
- vendor-attestations-cacheco-metricshub

Priority timeline:
- 2026-03-06: vendor outreach sent
- 2026-03-07: evidence folder skeleton in Drive + Confluence matrix updated
- 2026-03-10: most infra/eng evidence collected
- 2026-03-12: triage outstanding items and prepare cover memo
- 2026-03-15: external readiness review (mock/auditor kickoff)

Other misc notes (shorthand):
- Auditor Qs: expect to be asked about change rollback procedures, backup restoration tests, and whether dedicated customers' data paths are isolated by default.
- Keep copies of any vendor questionnaires even if they self-attest.

Next steps for the 1:1 with Priya:
- Run through the evidence gaps list; confirm owners and near-term deadlines.
- Agree on who will lead the auditor communications.
- Confirm whether we need additional attestation requests to Procurement.

-- ryan
(Will convert these notes into a Confluence draft and share with Priya/Maya after the 1:1)
